# Third-party files served by Elyssa

Pinned versions, downloaded from the npm registry (cdn.jsdelivr.net), MIT licensed (see the LICENSE files).

| File | Package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| uPlot.iife.min.js, uPlot.min.css | uplot | 1.6.30 |
| three.module.min.js | three | 0.160.0 |

They are embedded in the firmware (gzip) by `tools/embed_assets.py`, so the dashboard works without Internet access.
